name: lookup_order
description: Look up the shipping status of one Gisting Lab Store order. Call it only after the customer has written both the order number and the email address in this chat.

order_number.description: The order number the customer wrote, for example #1042.

email.description: The email address the customer wrote for this order. Never invent one: if the customer has not written an email, ask for it instead of calling the tool.
